{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: nightly acceptance tests on emulator

permissions:
  contents: read

on:
  schedule:
    # 06:00 UTC
    - cron:  '0 6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    services:
      emulator:
        image: gcr.io/cloud-spanner-emulator/emulator:1.5.59
        ports:
          - 9010:9010
          - 9020:9020

    strategy:
      max-parallel: 4
      matrix:
        ruby: ["3.2", "3.3", "3.4", "4.0"]
        ar: ["7.1", "7.2", "8.0", "8.1"]
        # Exclude combinations that are not supported.
        exclude:
          - ruby: "3.4"
            ar: "7.1"
          - ruby: "3.4"
            ar: "7.2"
          - ruby: "4.0"
            ar: "7.1"
          - ruby: "4.0"
            ar: "7.2"
    env:
      BUNDLE_GEMFILE: ${{ github.workspace }}/gemfiles/${{ matrix.ar }}.gemfile
      BUNDLE_PATH: vendor/bundle
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Set up Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@b3aaceaef7e0ee231b499e7b5f49c03fc1d32199 # v1.338.0
      with:
        # Disable caching as we are overriding the ActiveRecord below.
        bundler-cache: false
        ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby }}
    - name: Cache Bundler dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: vendor/bundle
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-gems-${{ matrix.ruby }}-${{ matrix.ar }}-${{ hashFiles('gemfiles/${{ matrix.ar }}.gemfile') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-gems-${{ matrix.ruby }}-${{ matrix.ar }}-
          ${{ runner.os }}-gems-${{ matrix.ruby }}-
          ${{ runner.os }}-gems-
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: bundle install
    - name: Run acceptance tests on emulator
      run: bundle exec rake acceptance
      env:
        SPANNER_EMULATOR_HOST: localhost:9010
        SPANNER_TEST_PROJECT: test-project
        SPANNER_TEST_INSTANCE: test-instance
",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs a matrix of Ruby and ActiveRecord versions nightly, performing a full `bundle install` each time. Evidence from a measured experiment (batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-3d6f1c5a422aa116-r2) on a similar Ruby matrix workflow shows that adding an explicit Bundler dependency cache (actions/cache) for `vendor/bundle` yields ~10.5% elapsed time savings. The pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE also supports caching dependency downloads when repeated fetching is measurable and cache inputs include the lockfile and environment. This workflow meets those preconditions: it uses distinct gemfiles per matrix combination (gemfiles/${{ matrix.ar }}.gemfile) and runs daily. The change adds a cache step keyed by OS, Ruby version, ActiveRecord version, and the gemfile hash, with fallback restore keys. It also sets BUNDLE_PATH=vendor/bundle so that `bundle install` uses the cached directory. No other behavior is altered; test coverage and required checks are preserved.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-3d6f1c5a422aa116-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}

name: nightly acceptance tests on emulator

          - 9010:9010
          - 9020:9020

      max-parallel: 4
      matrix:
        ruby: ["3.2", "3.3", "3.4", "4.0"]
        ar: ["7.1", "7.2", "8.0", "8.1"]
        # Exclude combinations that are not supported.
        exclude:
          - ruby: "3.4"
            ar: "7.1"
          - ruby: "3.4"
            ar: "7.2"
          - ruby: "4.0"
            ar: "7.1"
          - ruby: "4.0"
            ar: "7.2"
    env:
      BUNDLE_GEMFILE: ${{ github.workspace }}/gemfiles/${{ matrix.ar }}.gemfile
      BUNDLE_PATH: vendor/bundle
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Set up Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@b3aaceaef7e0ee231b499e7b5f49c03fc1d32199 # v1.338.0
      with:
        # Disable caching as we are overriding the ActiveRecord below.
        bundler-cache: false
        ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby }}
    - name: Cache Bundler dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: vendor/bundle
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-gems-${{ matrix.ruby }}-${{ matrix.ar }}-${{ hashFiles('gemfiles/${{ matrix.ar }}.gemfile') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-gems-${{ matrix.ruby }}-${{ matrix.ar }}-
          ${{ runner.os }}-gems-${{ matrix.ruby }}-
          ${{ runner.os }}-gems-
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: bundle install
    - name: Run acceptance tests on emulator
      run: bundle exec rake acceptance
      env:
        SPANNER_EMULATOR_HOST: localhost:9010
        SPANNER_TEST_PROJECT: test-project
        SPANNER_TEST_INSTANCE: test-instance
